name: sampler
title: Gear sampler: the plate
description: Pins for twelve pairs of 17-tooth gears, four modules by three backlashes, each pair at its centre distance and labelled; a rail for a loose rack and a lip for a loose ring, each with a pin for its pinion. Print it with sampler-gears and press the gears on (the mounted assembly, sampler-mounted, shows where each goes); record which pairs turn freely and how much play each has.

module_a.rule: The plate's rows: The smallest worth trying on a 0.4 mm nozzle: twice the nozzle

module_b.rule: The plate's rows: Module 1: 3.6 lines across a tooth

module_d.rule: The plate's rows: Module 2: comfortable, the largest tried

backlash_a.rule: The plate's columns: either side of the kit's 0.15 mm (FDM guides give 0.1 to 0.2)

backlash_b.rule: The plate's columns: either side of the kit's 0.15 mm (FDM guides give 0.1 to 0.2)

backlash_c.rule: The plate's columns: either side of the kit's 0.15 mm (FDM guides give 0.1 to 0.2)

teeth.rule: The fewest at 20° without a profile shift, so every pair is drawn the same way

pin.rule: A pin the gears turn on

pin_height.rule: Through the gear and two millimetres over

width.rule: The gears' face width, twenty layers

column.rule: Room for the largest pair (module 2: 34 mm apart, 38 mm tips) and its label

margin.rule: Between a row's tips and the next row's label

label.rule: Label height: a capital this tall

stroke.rule: Label lines two extrusion lines wide

emboss.rule: Labels three layers proud of the plate

rack_teeth.rule: A rack long enough to turn its pinion a full turn and more

ring_teeth.rule: A ring 23 teeth more than its 17-tooth pinion: well clear of the 10 where tips foul

check_backlash.rule: The rack's and ring's own backlash: the middle of the three

rack_bar.rule: The rack's bar under its roots: eight lines

rack_travel.rule: How far the rack slides each way: its pinion a little over a third of a turn

rail_width.rule: The rail behind the rack: six lines

rail_height.rule: Up most of the rack's width

clear.rule: Half a line between a loose part and what guides it, so it slides

lip_height.rule: Up most of the ring's width
